mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and may increase metabolism of lisdexamfetamine's active metabolite amphetamine, potentially reducing stimulant efficacy; concurrent CNS stimulation and possible additive effects on seizure threshold.
action: Monitor for reduced lisdexamfetamine efficacy; may require dose adjustment; counsel on seizure risk and CNS effects; baseline and periodic seizure history assessment recommended.
